source: Fresh original archives plus current-rewrite history of CI tooling only; no retired checkout inspected.

runs.failure: Select affected tests exited 2 for the large main-branch rewrite; output plan was redirected and shell errexit prevented cat. No tests were started.
runs.cause: The selector required a full audit for broad changes, but the old affected-only workflow had no source-bound full-closeout path. This is supported by the historical exit branches and changed build/shared files; the original plan JSON was not retained in that job.
runs.confidence: log-confirmed exit; exact rejected mapping not retained
runs.missed: First-release main/tag event semantics and broad selection were not dry-run before publish.
runs.fix: e1c232eb6e73 adds reviewed plan/full authorization workflow.
runs.prevention: Use current release-preflight on exact base/head, retain diagnostic output even when planning fails; do not interpret refusal as a product test failure.

runs.failure: Same initial release tag run exited 2 with invalid-or-unreadable-change-selection.
runs.cause: CHANGE_BASE was 40 zeroes for the tag push; gitChanges explicitly rejected zero revisions.
runs.missed: New tag events have no ordinary previous commit.
runs.fix: e1c232eb6e73 restricts push branches and introduces an explicit reviewed base / source-bound authorization; current workflow does not trigger tag pushes.
runs.prevention: Validate new-ref/tag/manual/PR events separately; never invent a base or silently skip a gate.

runs.failure: Current source scan clean; complete Git-object scan reported 32 pattern findings and exited 1.
runs.cause: Historical immutable objects matched credential/path patterns; initial CI had no retained per-object semantic classifications. Later review classified synthetic fixtures/placeholders. No historical source was re-opened in this retrospective.
runs.confidence: direct original scanner output; semantic classifications inherited from retained reviewed-history metadata
runs.missed: Current-tree-only validation did not exercise the remote complete-history gate.
runs.fix: dbabbdb7319c adds reviewed-history classifications, expanded in a3ec164b7c4c.
runs.prevention: Keep raw scanner strict; examine complete fetched object inventory, use exact object/line/rule dispositions, never whitelist current-source matches.

runs.failure: Security review blocked: An unreviewed finding or a current-source pattern blocks publication.
runs.cause: The first historical classification covered only a narrower immutable set; full fetched refs contained additional historical patterns. a3ec164b7c4c explicitly expands classifications across all remote branches/tags.
runs.confidence: direct block message and exact classifier repair diff; raw archive does not enumerate which single finding blocked first
runs.missed: Local object inventory differed from complete fetched hosted inventory.
runs.fix: a3ec164b7c4c expands exact immutable classifications; later plan logs show passed-with-reviewed-historical-patterns.
runs.prevention: Compare complete object universes before declaring scan closure; a local allowlist pass is not remote history acceptance.

runs.failure: Windows Prepare independent official CLI failed; GNU tar reported Cannot connect to D: resolve failed. Upload lacked result-windows.json; coverage then rejected missing platform report.
runs.cause: GNU tar selected by Git Bash interpreted the colon in the absolute Windows drive path as a remote archive host.
runs.confidence: direct tar error plus exact e8f006961cb8 extraction repair
runs.missed: Local Windows tar implementation differed from hosted PATH-selected GNU tar.
runs.fix: e8f006961cb8 uses a verified archive basename with native cwd; current scripts/prepare-ci-native.mjs retains it.
runs.prevention: Test preparation tools on actual supported shells/PATH, retain basename/path validation, distinguish preparation failure from downstream artifact/coverage refusal.
